name: Temporal Integration
description: Accumulation of evidence over time to support decision-making and perceptual inference. Integrates noisy inputs to improve signal-to-noise ratio. Central to sequential sampling, evidence accumulation, and temporal binding.
key_references: Usher, M., & McClelland, J. L. (2001). The time course of perceptual choice: the leaky competing accumulator model. Psychological Review, 108(3), 550-592.
Shadlen, M. N., & Newsome, W. T. (2001). Neural basis of a perceptual decision in the parietal cortex (area LIP) of the macaque. Journal of Neurophysiology, 86(4), 1916-1936.
empirical_evidence: Neural correlate: ramping activity in parietal and prefrontal cortex during decision formation. Predicts reaction times and choices. Mathematical fit: log-likelihood ratio (LLR) or diffusion model with drift and noise. Applies to both sensory and value-based decisions.

parameters.integration_method: leaky integration via membrane time constant
